# HireALineDancer.com

HireALineDancer.com is a directory for hiring line dance instructors for weddings, corporate events, bachelorette parties, venues, schools, community events, and private parties.

Important pages:
- /: national search and marketplace overview.
- /pricing/: founding instructor offer and guarantee.
- /apply/: instructor application.
- /cities/: local line dance instructor landing pages.
- /events/: event-type service pages.
- /guides/cost-to-hire-line-dance-instructor/: buyer pricing guide.

The site is intended to be crawled by search engines and AI assistants. Instructor profile pages describe independent service providers; buyers should confirm rates, insurance, availability, travel, and event details directly with each instructor.
